title: Provider evidence execution timestamps must use the market-time +08:00 offset
context: Provider evidence already required a timezone-aware executed_at and separately required units.timezone=Asia/Shanghai. However executed_at could still be encoded with any UTC offset. Because sample.end_date is compared against executed_at.date(), an arbitrary offset could shift the calendar date away from the A-share market-date semantics declared by the evidence contract.

decision.reason: keep sample-date and execution-date comparisons on one explicit market-time basis

scope_note: This closes a credential-free calendar-time consistency gap only. It does not prove provider permission, data completeness, boundary truth, strategy profitability or holdout readiness.
